SPECIALIZED ENGLISH

Compete at the trade port

Turn order: 🐱 Red → 🐶 Blue → 🐔 Yellow → 🐷 Green.

Each team has its own token and score. Roll the dice to move 1–6 tiles, then choose the correct Vietnamese meaning from 3 options.

Correct: +10 points. Wrong: no points, and the correct meaning is shown. Each question can only be answered once.

The board has 20 tiles: 16 vocabulary tiles and 4 special corner tiles — 🚩 Start, ⭐ +10 points, 🔒 Jail (lose a turn), ⚠️ -10 points.

Round 1: a vocabulary tile already answered by another team shows a ✔ mark (claimed); if you land on it, your token automatically moves on to the next unclaimed vocabulary tile, so every team gets a question in the first round.

From round 2 onward: landing on a ✔-marked vocabulary tile means you lose your turn immediately, with no new question. Unclaimed tiles still ask a question as usual.

After each question (or each special/lost turn), click to switch teams. Going all the way around the board returns to tile 1. There is no turn limit — compare scores whenever you end the session.
